selected_branches.branch: Sight-conditioned traversal with neither stated exception.

law_text: The prima facie speed limit shall be fifteen miles per hour when traversing any intersection or street or highway if during the last one hundred feet of his approach to such intersection the driver does not have a clear and unobstructed view of such intersection and of any traffic upon all of the streets or highways entering such intersection for a distance of one hundred feet along all such streets or highways, except on a through street or highway or at a traffic-controlled intersection.

required_context: Document intersection boundaries and the distance method for the last one hundred feet of approach.
Document through-road and intersection-control status without equating the absence of one device with the absence of all qualifying control.
Establish jurisdiction, street or highway status, driver control and a qualifying intersection rather than an alley junction.
Municipal jurisdiction, street or highway status, driver identity and actual control.
Neither through-street/highway nor traffic-controlled-intersection exception applies.
Occluders and view evidence covering the intersection and traffic throughout every entering street's or highway's one-hundred-foot extent.
Preserve unresolved scope, visibility meanings, temporal aggregation and municipal incorporation.
Provide intersection-view and traffic-view coverage along every entering street or highway for one hundred feet.
Qualifying intersection geometry, traversal route and documented approach-distance reference.
Retain traversal speed against the fifteen-mile-per-hour prima facie value without adding an approach-speed duty.
witness_review.reason: The intersection permits a traversal witness with compatible physical occlusion and neither exception.
